'''Hover Lights''' were spherical [[repulsorlift]]-powered bulbs meant to serve as mobile light sources that could follow their user. They were used sometime during or after the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="Cartel Market" />

{{Tech-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Hover Light weapon tuning was inspired by elements from the [[The Bad Batch Season 1|first season]] of the [[Disney+]] television series [[Star Wars: The Mandalorian|''The Mandalorian'']].<ref name="Cartel Market" /><ref name="The Mandalorian">''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]]''</ref> It first appeared in [[BioWare]]'s [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Cartel Market" />
